question: The first High Court in India was established in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1862**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In 1862, the British colonial administration in India** established the first three High Courts in the country.
 
• These were set up in the three Presidency towns of **Calcutta (now Kolkata), Bombay (now Mumbai), and Madras (now Chennai).**
